name: War Training
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level alchemist 4, antipaladin 3, cleric 4, inquisitor 4, magus 4, paladin 3, sorcerer/wizard 4, vanguard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (the crest of an army)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You grant a creature the knowledge and skill with an assortment of weapons and armor, preparing it for battle. The creature gains proficiency in all simple weapons, martial weapons, armor, and shields (including tower shields). This does not grant an arcane spellcaster the ability to ignore arcane armor failure chance.
